answer: Faking identities requires acquiring and staking fresh jade per sybil, plus maintaining valid trellis attestations from real peers, so the attacker's marginal cost scales linearly with each fake node while honest agents pay nothing extra. Agents stake a unique jade token bound to a verified hardware root, and each epoch they must light a lantern challenge whose proof grows a trellis of attested peer links. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
